items.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 4164d3de 'fix(sessionstart): preserve live UUID events on fresh-startup cleanup' (Mert Koseoglu, 2026-05-10). ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit message, quoted): 'This assumed session_meta was the source of truth for "is this session real?". It isn't — there is a timing window where insertEvent has fired for a session_id but ensureSession has not yet written the meta row. On a power-outage restart this wiped 1000+ events of real Claude Code work.' Fix changed the blanket DELETE in hooks/sessionstart.mjs to spare session_ids that look like a live UUID and are under 7 days old, backed by tests/session/cleanup-preserves-live-uuid-events.test.ts (5 cases). REGRESSION_RISK: DECISIONS-r3 Q7 sets v2 retention as 'age + live owner PID + size cap (#962)' — this is a different mechanism (PID liveness, not UUID-shape + age heuristic) and must still pass the same five behaviors the v1 test encodes, or the #1140/4164d3de bug returns under the new mechanism.
items.regressions: If v2's PID-liveness check has any timing gap between event insert and session registration (the same gap 4164d3de fixed), active sessions get evicted again. The 7-day/UUID-GLOB heuristic in v1 was itself a workaround for that gap, not a root-cause fix — v2 should confirm PID-liveness closes the gap directly.
items.question: none open — DECISIONS-r3 Q7 already answers it.
items.recommendation: Change verdict from r2's needs-decision to closed-by-design: Q7 in DECISIONS-r3.md settles this (retention = age + live owner PID + size cap). Port tests/session/cleanup-preserves-live-uuid-events.test.ts intent into a GP6/GP8 case for the new PID-based mechanism — do not just delete the v1 test, since it is the only artifact proving the original bug is still fixed.
